mne.create.title: Create a monitoring report from a form, a period and a snapshot
mne.create.help: The report is made as a draft: the cells that have a source are filled from the frozen snapshot, the preparer writes the rest and hands it in for review. A report that already exists for the same form, period and unit is refused.
mne.create.form.label: Form in force
mne.create.form.none: No published form is in force: publish a form in the form catalogue first.
mne.create.lookup.error: The list to choose from could not be loaded. Try again.
mne.create.year.label: Report year
mne.create.period.label: Name of the period
mne.create.period.hint: At most {max} characters, for example Quarter 3 or Full year.
mne.create.unit.label: Reporting unit
mne.create.project.label: Project (only for the report of one project)
mne.create.project.hint: Leave empty when the report is about the whole unit.
mne.create.snapshot.label: Frozen snapshot
mne.create.snapshot.hint: The cells with a source take their numbers from this snapshot; it can be attached later, but the report cannot be handed in without one.
mne.create.error.year: Enter a four-digit year from 2000 to 2100.
mne.create.error.periodLong: The name of the period is at most {max} characters.
mne.create.info.name: Numbers filled in the report
mne.create.info.formula: Each cell with a source takes the value of its source metric on the as-of day of the chosen frozen snapshot; a cell without a source is written by the preparer.
mne.correct.denied: An issued report is not changed. You do not have the right to make a correction.
mne.correct.title: Correct revision {revision} of the report
mne.correct.help: A correction makes a new draft revision with the reason; the issued revision is kept as it was. The new revision goes through review, approval and issue through DOC again, and the person who corrects does not approve their own correction.
mne.correct.reason.label: Reason for the correction
mne.correct.reason.hint: From {min} to {max} characters; say what was wrong and why.
mne.correct.error.short: The reason needs at least {min} characters.
mne.correct.error.long: The reason is at most {max} characters.
mne.correct.snapshot.label: Snapshot to fill the cells again
mne.correct.snapshot.hint: Choose another snapshot if the source numbers must be taken again; the cells with a source are filled again from it.
mne.report.problem.correctionReason: The reason for the correction is not enough: it needs at least 10 characters.
pay.manual.open: Confirm with the Treasury by hand
pay.manual.title: Manual confirmation of payment request {no}
pay.manual.done: The Treasury transaction of the request was confirmed by hand.
pay.manual.help: Used when the Treasury file did not bring the transaction. It needs the number and day of the Treasury document, the amount paid and the evidence kept in DOC. An amount that differs from the net amount of the request opens a difference to reconcile and does not settle the request; whoever sent the request to the Treasury cannot confirm it.
pay.manual.amountHint: A whole number; it starts as the net amount of the request.
pay.manual.evidence: Id of the evidence version in DOC
pay.manual.evidenceHint: The identifier of the document version of the evidence uploaded to DOC.
pay.manual.error.amount: Enter the amount as a whole number, not negative.
pay.manual.error.future: It cannot be in the future.
pay.manual.error.instant: Enter a real date and time.
pay.manual.error.uuid: The id must be an identifier (36 characters).
pay.manual.error.long: The document number is too long.
pay.manual.refused.duplicate: This transaction was recorded before: it is not recorded twice.
pay.manual.refused.mismatch: The amount does not match the request: a difference was opened to reconcile and the request is not settled.
bid.clarifications.opened.notice: Showing the clarification request you opened from a link. Choose a package to see the others.
bid.report.opened.notice: Showing the evaluation report you opened from a link. Choose a package to see the others.
bid.passages.title: Find passages in the proposals
bid.passages.help: Find the passages of the proposals you have in full that are nearest to a question. Only the pages you may read are compared; the result is for reading and does not rank the bidders.
bid.passages.model.label: Embedding model used to compare
bid.passages.model.error: The list of models could not be loaded.
bid.passages.model.none: No knowledge set uses an approved embedding model yet.
bid.passages.question.label: Question
bid.passages.limit.label: Most passages
bid.passages.error.questionLong: The question is at most {max} characters.
bid.passages.error.limit: The number of passages is from 1 to {max}.
bid.passages.refused.undeclared: You have not declared that you have no conflict of interest with this package: declare before searching.
bid.passages.refused.route: This AI route is not allowed for the class of the files.
bid.passages.refused.killSwitch: The AI feature is switched off in an emergency.
bid.passages.refused.model: The model is not approved for use.
bid.passages.refused.validation: The question or the model is not valid.
bid.passages.refused.denied: You do not have the right to this package.
bid.passages.refused.general: The search could not be made now.
bid.passages.empty: No passage is near the question in the proposals you may read.
bid.passages.distance.formula: The distance between the vector of the question and the vector of the passage in the chosen embedding model; the smaller, the nearer. It only orders what to read first and is not a score of the evaluation.
omni.link.open: Tie to a project, an issue or a contract
omni.link.form.aria: Tie the conversation to a record
omni.link.help: Tie the conversation to a record in your scope so that the people in charge see it. A record outside your scope is refused like one that does not exist.
omni.link.kind.label: Kind of record
omni.link.resource.label: Record
omni.link.lookup.error: The list of projects could not be loaded: enter the identifier of the project.
omni.link.error.uuid: The id must be an identifier (36 characters).
omni.link.done: The conversation was tied to the record.
omni.link.refused.scope: The record is outside your scope or does not exist.
omni.link.refused.state: The conversation is in a state that does not allow another tie.
omni.link.refused.conflict: The conversation changed: reload and try again.
omni.link.refused.general: The tie could not be made now; try again.
llm.reconcile.title: Decide the reconciliation of usage that did not come back
llm.reconcile.help: The reservations below have not received their actual usage. Approving keeps the amount held, returning sends them to be measured again, rejecting releases the amount held. Only the reservations you choose are reconciled, and the reason is kept.
llm.reconcile.decision.label: Decision
llm.reconcile.reason.label: Reason
llm.reconcile.error.reasonShort: The reason needs at least {min} characters.
llm.reconcile.error.reasonLong: The reason is at most {max} characters.
